meta.data_description_zh:
提供1979年至最新發表年度癌症個案歸戶後之年報資料，包含各癌症原位癌及侵
襲癌個案。其資料的整理包含所有長表及短表醫院申報資料，且已去除同一個案同
一癌症別，且同一組織型態組別之重複個案。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 原位癌或侵襲癌個案之辨識，請以組織型態性態碼(HISTBEH欄位第 5碼)區
分。
2. 有關死亡原因及死亡日期欄位，為醫院申報當時之資料，若後續個案死亡，並
不會再做更新，故不提供此欄位資料以免誤解。若有需要，請直接連結死因統
計檔(Health-10)。
3. 癌症部分(CASITE欄位)，已新增為5碼，若第1碼為”H”者，表示為血液腫瘤
個案。若要再細分NHL(非何杰金氏淋巴瘤)、HL(何杰金氏淋巴瘤)及LEU(白血
病)等血液腫瘤個案，必須以組織病理(HISTBEH欄位)作區分。若是要分析各癌
症部分(CASITE欄位)，請先把NHL、HL、LEU等血液腫瘤排除後再計算。
4. 2002年起診斷之新發癌症個案，始收錄分級分化程度(GRADE 欄位)資料。另自
2018年起新增編碼A/B/C/D/E/H/L/M/S/X(詳見107年版癌症登記摘錄手冊短表
45欄位與長表115欄位內容)
5. 治療情形(TX欄位)已合併個案所有申報醫院治療狀況。2007年以後收錄之詳細
治療資料，請另見長、短表治療欄位。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。 1. 身分證字號(ID)經加密處理。
2. 個人歸戶及個人資料對照的鍵值：ID。
meta.data_description_en: Provides annual reports from 1979 to the latest published year for cancer cases after householding, including in situ and invasive cases of all cancers. The data includes both long-form and short-form hospital claims and has removed duplicate cases within the same case for the same type of cancer and tissue type group.
meta.notes_en: 1. To meet clinical cancer-care needs, from ROC 98 (2009) the HPA began planning to add site-specific-factor data to the Taiwan Cancer Registry long-form database; for public-health reasons, smoking, betel-nut chewing, alcohol use, height, and weight were added and revised in the ROC-100 (2011) abstracting manual. 2. Beyond the cancers reported in 2007 (cervical, breast, colorectal, oral, lung, liver) and added in 2008 (prostate, stomach, esophagus, bladder), 2009 added nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic cancers; 2010 expanded to the top 10 cancers in men and women (oral, colorectal, liver, lung, breast, cervical, esophagus, stomach, prostate, bladder, major salivary gland, nasopharyngeal, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic tumors). From 2013, laryngeal cancer was added, and some hospitals reported the all-cancer long form from diagnosis year 2013. 3. Eligible cases are ROC nationals (foreigners excluded) first diagnosed with cancer by a physician. 4. In principle each cancer case is reported once, but another primary site (i.e. multiple primary cancer) requires an additional report. 5. Cancer cases newly diagnosed on or after 1 January 2011 are reported per the ROC-100 abstracting manual. 6. First-recurrence data records whether a first cancer recurrence occurs within five years of follow-up after diagnosis; only case classes 1 and 2 must report this field. If recurrence repeats after a first recurrence within five years, only the first recurrence status is recorded; if a first recurrence occurs after five years, the field is recorded as no recurrence. Recurrence data is reported once at one year and once at five years after diagnosis.

meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health45_癌症登記年報檔(20250624起適用)
meta.data_description_en: Provides annual reports from 1979 to the latest published year for cancer cases after householding, including in situ and invasive cases of all cancers. The data includes both long-form and short-form hospital claims and has removed duplicate cases within the same case for the same type of cancer and tissue type group.
meta.notes_en:
1. This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
2. To distinguish in-situ carcinoma from invasive carcinoma cases, use the histology behavior code (5th digit of the HISTOLOG field).
3. The date-of-death and cause-of-death fields reflect the data as reported by the hospital at the time; if the case subsequently dies, these fields are not updated, so this field's data is not provided in order to avoid misinterpretation. If needed, please link directly to the Cause of Death Statistics File (Health-10).
4. Hematologic malignancy cases such as NHL (non-Hodgkin's lymphoma), HL (Hodgkin's lymphoma), and LEU (leukemia) must be distinguished using the histopathology field (HISTBEH). When analyzing by cancer site (CASITE field), first exclude NHL, HL, LEU, and other hematologic malignancies before calculating.
5. A histopathology (HISTOLOG field) value of 99903 applies only to codes used in 2001 (ROC year 90) or earlier, meaning clinically malignant tumors not confirmed by microscopic examination.
6. Grade/differentiation data (GRADE field) has only been collected for newly diagnosed cancer cases from 2002 onward. In addition, starting in 2018, codes A/B/C/D/E/H/L/M/S/X were added (see the 2018/ROC year 107 edition Cancer Registry Abstracting Manual, short-form field 45 and long-form field 115, for details).
7. The treatment status field (CURECOND) has been consolidated across all reporting hospitals for a case. For detailed treatment data collected from 2007 onward, see the separate long-form and short-form treatment fields.
1. The ID number (IDNO) is encrypted.
2. The key for linking records to an individual and matching individual data: IDNO.
